items.title: Edwards Lifesciences (EW) Stock Still Looks Reasonable On Cash Flow
items.summary: Edwards Lifesciences has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, and that climb naturally raises a simple question for you as an investor. Is the current US$106.00 price broadly aligned with the cash flows the business can generate or is the market getting ahead of itself. The stock is up 55.1% over the past 3 years, which puts real weight on whether today’s valuation is still grounded in the company’s cash generating power. items.title: Is Edwards Lifesciences (EW) Fully Priced Following Its New $750 Million Credit Agreement?
items.summary: Edwards Lifesciences (EW) recently refreshed its core borrowing toolkit through an amended five year credit agreement, giving the medical device group renewed access to a US$750 million revolving facility on extended terms.
